Before you ask

Your questions, answered

Does the agent touch my live site directly?

No. Work is drafted and reviewed first; only an approved change reaches the running site.

Which platforms are supported?

WordPress and Joomla today, Shopify next. Each has its own set of skills.

What happens if a change goes wrong?

Every change is recorded under its own id. One call puts the whole deliverable back.

Can I cancel?

Any time. Clearing the token revokes everything at once.
